Campus Sans / Campus Serif are renamed WOFF2 subsets of Adobe Source Han Sans / Source Han Serif, licensed under SIL OFL 1.1; see the accompanying licenses. Original font copyright and license metadata are retained.
Motto SVG files are fixed lettering artwork in the user-selected Xingkai SC Light style; they contain paths, not downloadable font software.
Regenerate text font subsets with scripts/build_typography.py when adding site copy.
